environmentNotes: On the very first launch attempt, the app auto-restored a previously-opened workspace (from an unrelated sibling checkout used by an earlier task) via what appears to be macOS-level Electron window-state restoration keyed by the app's bundle identifier — this is independent of --user-data-dir. That instance's window closed unexpectedly (~5 min in, clean backend-contribution shutdown in the log, cause not fully diagnosed) before scripted scenario steps ran; it was relaunched fresh and produced no filesystem side effects (confirmed via a git-status check on the affected sibling checkout, which showed zero diff both before relaunch and after all scenarios completed). All scenario evidence in this report is from the second, successful launch.

The second launch did not auto-restore a workspace, so the app started with an empty workspace and every scenario was driven only against scratch fixtures below <SCRATCH>, never against any real project/repo.
